new tax regime is selected. Eligible amount of deduction claimed u/s 80QQB should not be more than user enterable amount
Eligible amount of deduction claimed u/s 80RRB should not be more than user enterable amount
In Schedule VI A, for deductions u/s 80CCC the sum of individual rows for "Amount " shall match with the "Amount of Payment" as per the field 80CCC.
If Deduction u/s 80CCC is more than 0 then it shall be mandatory to add at least one row and provide details for "Type of identifier", "Identifier No. and "Amount"
If Old Tax Regime is selected and Deductions u/s 80EEA and 80EE cannot be claimed simultaneously
Total Income at Schedule AMT is Negative. But the loss in Total Income can only arise because of the Specified business.
In Schedule AMT, Tax payable under section 115JC should be equal to 9% of 3a for assessee falling within the IFSC area+ 18.5% of Sl.No.3b for assessee not falling within
the IFSC area. In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 1 should be equal to Sl.No. 14 of Part BTI 48
In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 2a should be equal to sum of system computed part C deductions under Schedule VIA.
In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 2d Adjustment as per section 115JC(2) should be equal to sum of Sl.No. 2a+2b+2c
In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 3 Adjusted Total Income under section 115JC should be equal to sum of Sl.No. 1+2d
In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 4 "Tax payable under section 115JC" shall be computed if Adjusted Total Income under section 115JC is more than Rs. 20 Lakh and Adjustment as
per section 115JC(2) is more than zero. Schedule AMT should be blank if "New Tax Regime" is selected
In Schedule AMT, Sl.no 3b should be difference of Sl.no 3-3a
In Schedule AMT, Sl.no 3 should be equal to Sl.no 3a+3b
In Schedule AMT, Sl.No. 2b should be equal to total deduction under section 10AA.
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 1 should be equal to Sl.No. 1d of Part B-TTI.
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 2 should be equal to Sl.No. 2i of Part B-TTI.
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 3 should be equal to Sl.No. 2-1
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 3 should be equal to zero when Sl.No. 2 is less than or equal to Sl.No. 1
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 5 "Amount of tax credit under section 115JD utilized during the year" should be equal to Total of Col 4(C).
In Schedule AMTC, Sl.No. 6 "Amount of AMT liability available for credit in subsequent assessment years" should be equal to Total of Col 4(D).
In Schedule AMTC, value at Sl. No. B2(xii) cannot be greater than zero i.e. set off in earlier assessment years cannot be claimed for AY 2025-26
In Schedule Part B-TTI, AMT Credit u/s 115JD claimed should be equal to the amount of Credit at Schedule AMTC.
In Schedule AMTC, values at column C and column D should not be more than zero if "New Tax Regime" is selected
In Schedule SI, Column Income (i) for Tax on accumulated balance of recognized provident fund should be equal to Sl.No. 2ciii (Income Benefit) of Schedule OS
In schedule SI, Tax on accumulated balance of recognized provident fund should be equal to Sl.No. 2civ (tax benefit) of Schedule OS 49
